mapper.select: select t.task_id, t.instance_id, t.node_id, t.node_name, t.assignee, t.assignee_name, t.status, t.comment, t.approve_time, t.create_time, i.flow_name, i.biz_type, i.biz_id, i.biz_code, i.biz_name, i.status instance_status, i.submit_by, i.submit_name, i.submit_time from pm_flow_task t join pm_flow_instance i on i.instance_id = t.instance_id where t.task_id = #{taskId}
select task_id, instance_id, node_id, node_name, assignee, assignee_name, status, comment, approve_time, create_time from pm_flow_task where instance_id = #{instanceId} and status = 'PENDING'
select count(*) from pm_flow_task where assignee = #{assignee} and status = 'PENDING'

select t.task_id, t.instance_id, t.node_id, t.node_name, t.assignee, t.assignee_name, t.status, t.comment, t.approve_time, t.create_time, i.flow_name, i.biz_type, i.biz_id, i.biz_code, i.biz_name, i.status instance_status, i.submit_by, i.submit_name, i.submit_time from pm_flow_task t join pm_flow_instance i on i.instance_id = t.instance_id where t.assignee = #{assignee} and t.status in ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') order by t.approve_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into pm_flow_task(instance_id, node_id, node_name, assignee, assignee_name, status, create_time) values(#{instanceId}, #{nodeId}, #{nodeName}, #{assignee}, #{assigneeName}, #{status}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update pm_flow_task set status = 'SKIPPED', comment = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where instance_id = #{instanceId} and status = 'PENDING'
